Frozen Dagger

Item

Weapon (Dagger), Uncommon (requires attunement)

A dagger with a leather grip and a hilt in the shape of a snowflake. Its blade is also coated in a layer of sharp ice. Once per long rest, you can cast Ice Knife at will, with 13 as the DC.
